title: Sealing Three Prodigies
summary: Inside the Hall of Divine Light, a black altar protected by Source Arts holds a beast-hide scroll with the Nine Secrets inheritance. Jin Chi says he only wants the Black-Yellow Source Root and agrees to break the formation with Yaoguang. Lu Ling tells Ye Fan her family records mention a Chaos Stone carrying a Great Emperor's aura; triggering it presses everyone down to Dao Palace Level 3, and it will fully wake in 15 minutes. Ye Fan reveals himself and fights the Yaoguang Holy Son, Yao Xi and Jin Chi at once. When the Chaos Stone's field freezes everyone, he protects himself with the Black-Yellow Mother Qi and seals all three prodigies in his fire furnace, warning the families that he will hold them for a year and hurt them if he is followed. The scroll shows a Holy Cliff stained by a fallen Ancient Holy Body and a map of Purple Mountain, and on Hei Huang's advice they trick Duan De into taking the map as bait. Meanwhile Ji Ziyue tells a Ji elder she will train alone until she reaches the Four Poles.
